originals.citation: Pfeiffer, E. A., Johnson, T. M., & Chiofolo, R. C. (1981). Functional assessment of elderly subjects in four service settings. Journal of the American Geriatrics Society.

quote: This replication study further supports the hypothesis that the Functional Assessment Inventory (FAI) can reliably distinguish between the elderly in different service settings.
notes: Full text not read; the 1981 four-settings study is the direct precursor (four -> five settings, FAI distinguishing settings). Cairl1983/Robinson1986 are reliability/validation studies.
